'''''Vozburk''''' was a concept found in [[S'kytri mythology]]. It referred to an all-out conflict between the [[S'kytri|Windborn]] and the ground-dwelling [[Demon/Legends|demons]] of [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], that term had become archaic in [[S'kytric]]. However, it was used as the code name of an [[Attack plan Vozburk|attack plan]] designed to defeat the genetics terrorist [[Zeta Magnus]], who had [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the Windborn.
